title: The Votive Candles
text: Hundreds of votive candles burn before a shrine, one for each pilgrim's prayer, their wax running together in a pale river down the steps. The heat is thick and drowsy. The priest asks for an offering.

options.label: Light a candle for the party, and add your prayer to the river.

outcomes.text: A small flame among hundreds, and it leans toward you.

options.label: The newest Scion lights one for luck, while they still believe in it.

outcomes.text: A flame that burns bright and steady.
A flame that will not stay lit, however often they try.

options.label: The Leader gathers the spent wax to sell. The prayers are already said.

outcomes.text: Holy wax fetches a price, and the priest watches every scrape.
